tagline: Dayton roofing from a company with a Dayton address

why_choose_us.title: A Dayton address, not a phone number
why_choose_us.description: We work out of 3347 Witherspoon Drive in Dayton. After the storm crews have moved on to the next county, we are still here — same address, same phone, same two owners.

why_choose_us.title: CertainTeed ShingleMaster credentialed
why_choose_us.description: Ohio issues no statewide roofing license, so manufacturer credentials are one of the few things you can actually verify. ShingleMaster status is earned through CertainTeed and has to be maintained.

why_choose_us.title: BBB Accredited with an A+ rating
why_choose_us.description: The same Better Business Bureau that warns Miami Valley homeowners about storm chasers accredits us. Look us up before you call — that is the point.

why_choose_us.title: Written estimates, no pressure to sign
why_choose_us.description: You get the scope and the number in writing, and time to compare it against anyone else. Anyone who needs a signature today is telling you something.

_removed_keys_note: us_vs_them and the site-wide gallery are intentionally absent. Neither is rendered by the owl template — UsVsThem is a firefly-only section, and /our-work builds its strips from per-service `gallery` frontmatter, not config.gallery. Populating them here would look like configuration while doing nothing. The photos live in the service markdown instead.
